marco: Heads up — ops rolled the vault-proxy audit-sampler to 100% in eu-west this morning. Seeing KMS latency spikes and GPU warm pool failing to claim nodes. Anyone oncall?
ashley: On it. Confirming increased KMS QPS from the proxy. Correlated spikes at 08:12 and repeated node join timeouts. Keystore logs are full of `decrypt` 5xxs and some IAM deny traces :grimace: 
sre-bot: ALERT: 08:12:34 vault-proxy(eu-west) increased audit-sample -> 1.0; KMS latency 95p 1.3s; GPU-fleet join rate dropped 37% in 5m window.
marco: Ugh. We rolled this to unblock a compliance test. Was supposed to be 0.1. Can we throttle back? Also cost will balloon — long tail of logs to S3 and export charges.
ashley: Short-term mitigation: revert sampler to 0.1 in eu-west proxy group, pause audit export stream to SIEM for 30m, and bump warm-pool target by +10 nodes to keep headroom while we stabilize.
liz: Agree. Revert step is ready: `terraform apply -var='region=eu-west' -target=module.vault_proxy.aws_s3_bucket.policy` (will also need to flip sample_rate in proxy config). Planning a canary revert then region-wide.
andrew: Quick note — the decrypt 5xxs look like transient KMS throttling, but I also see increased conntrack on natgw. Firewall/NACL counters show more established than usual. Could be audit stream opening many ephemeral connections.
marco: So two knobs: sampler rate + audit-export path. Which is fastest?
ashley: Sampler rate flip is fastest (config change on proxy fleet). Audit export pause requires SIEM approval (security). I'll do sampler revert now and post the deploy-bot confirmation.
ashley: `kubectl -n ops set env deploy/vault-proxy AUDIT_SAMPLER=0.1 --record`
sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for vault-proxy (ops) in eu-west — rollout id r-20240308-01
marco: :thumbsup: also assign someone to monitor GPU allocator headroom metric (gpu.warm_pool.available) for the next 15m. If it still drops below 20% let's route traffic to dedicated capacity.
liz: I'll wire an alert for gpu.warm_pool.available < 0.2 for 10m and add runbook link.
andrew: If we need a fast firewall tweak, we can temporarily widen ephemeral port NAT timeout, but that's a last resort. Might hide the real throttling.
ashley: Revert done, monitoring logs now. Early signs: KMS p95 dropped to 320ms after 60s, GPU join rate recovering.
marco: Great. For follow-up: 1) security to weigh in on temporary SIEM pause and any IAM allowlist. 2) infra to add canary to the sampler rollout pipeline (start at 0.01 -> 0.1 -> 1.0). 3) product compliance to confirm why 100% was requested. 4) cost estimate for audit export delta (S3 + SIEM egress).
ashley: I'll file a lightweight postmortem and tag security + compliance.
liz: Also proposing a small perf test harness that simulates audit sample load before we flip region-wide. Could use existing load-driver in `tools/telemetry-sim`.
andrew: FYI I saw one IAM role that had `kms:Decrypt` denied by condition on sourceVpc — adding a short-lived grant for the warm-pool role might help joins during audit bursts if we keep sampling higher. Security approval required.
marco: OK let's avoid role changes unless necessary. We'll do the revert + export pause and then converge on safer rollout paths. Thanks everyone.
sre-bot: CLOSED: rollout r-20240308-01 succeeded after sampler revert; follow-ups assigned in #incidents.
